meta.name: rank-tracker
meta.description: Use when the user asks to "track rankings" or "查排名"; measures keyword and SERP-position deltas over time from provided exports or connected tools, including AI-response checks. Not for multi-metric stakeholder reports — use performance-reporter; not for setting alerts — use alert-manager. 排名追踪/SERP监控

copy.tagline: 追踪关键词排名和搜索结果变化
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要监控网站在搜索引擎中的关键词排名变化。
copy.tagline_en: Track keyword rankings and SERP changes over time.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to monitor your website's keyword rankings in search engines.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以追踪指定网站在搜索引擎中的关键词排名变化，包括普通搜索结果、SERP 特色功能和 AI 摘要可见性，并生成带数据来源标签的排名报告。
howto.when: 当用户要求“追踪排名”或“查排名”，或者要求监控关键词排名、比较排名快照、检测排名下降时触发。

say.text: 分析 example.com 过去两周的排名变化。
say.note: Claude 会对比基线，输出涨跌最大的关键词和可能原因。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can track keyword ranking changes for a specified domain in search engines, including SERP features and AI visibility, and generate a ranking report with source tags for each metric.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to "track rankings" or "查排名", or requests monitoring keyword rankings, comparing ranking snapshots, or detecting ranking drops.

say_en.text: Track rankings for example.com with keywords: SEO tools, content marketing.
say_en.note: Claude will set up tracking and record current positions as baseline.

say_en.text: Analyze ranking changes for example.com over the past two weeks.
